title: Music Farm

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Music Farm offers a newly renovated, flexible multi-purpose space that is ideal for your special event. With a capacity of 675 and the ability to seat 250 guests, the main floor of the 16,000 square-foot space is broken up into three different levels offering spaces to dance, dine and celebrate. This modern venue housed in a historic train depot is ideal for live entertainment. Located in historic Downtown Charleston and housed in a train depot built in 1850, the Music Farm has been one of Charleston’s most iconic venues since 1992. services.desc: After the smashing success of Shrek Burlesque and Bubble Burlesque, the Music Farm’s specialty burlesque show is back with 90s Burlesque! Slip on your choker. Slap on your bracelet. Adjust your mood rings! We are celebrating all things 90s with our newest burlesque show. 8 burlesque performers will be paying tribute to the decade with some outlandish performances.
